{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsortube''' was a tube filled with a cushion of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] energy. They allowed individuals to traverse the lower level of the tube without the need for a lift car. [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessels]] such as the ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]'' used repulsortubes.
